description: Build the structure evidence matrix, the GO decision lead table, and a per-structure DDB1 vs DDB2 distance figure
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- Artifact 1: structure-level evidence table ----------
R = pd.read_csv("ddb1_dna_contacts_full.csv")
P = pd.read_csv("ddb1_dna_structures_provenance.csv")
S = (R[R.protein.isin(["DDB1","DDB2"])]
     .pivot_table(index="pdb", columns="protein",
                  values=["min_dist","c40"], aggfunc={"min_dist":"min","c40":"max"}))
S.columns = [f"{b}_{a}" for a,b in S.columns]
S = S.join(P.set_index("pdb")[["method","res","pmid","first_author","year"]])
S = S[["method","res","pmid","first_author","year",
       "DDB1_min_dist","DDB1_c40","DDB2_min_dist","DDB2_c40"]]
S.columns = ["method","resolution_A","PMID","first_author","year",
             "DDB1_min_dist_to_DNA_A","DDB1_atoms_lt4A","DDB2_min_dist_to_DNA_A","DDB2_atoms_lt4A"]
S.to_csv("TABLE_structure_evidence_matrix.csv")
pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print("TABLE 1: per-structure DNA contact census\n")
print(S.to_string())

# ---------- Artifact 2: GO decision table ----------
go = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(gene="DDB1", go_id="GO:0003684", go_term="damaged DNA binding", aspect="MF",
      current_qualifier="enables", current_evidence="TAS", current_ref="PMID:8407967", source="ProtInc",
      lead="Down-qualify to contributes_to or remove",
      rationale="1993 assay used the copurified p124/p41 heterodimer; 22 DDB1 chains in 20 PDB entries show 0 atoms within 5 A of DNA (median 27.7 A)."),
 dict(gene="DDB1", go_id="GO:0003677", go_term="DNA binding", aspect="MF",
      current_qualifier="enables", current_evidence="TAS", current_ref="PMID:8798680", source="ProtInc",
      lead="Remove or mark non-core",
      rationale="No DDB1 residue approaches DNA in any UV-DDB, CRL4(DDB2) or CRL4(CSA)-Pol II structure; generic DNA binding is less informative than DDB1's adaptor activity."),
 dict(gene="DDB1", go_id="GO:0003684", go_term="damaged DNA binding", aspect="MF",
      current_qualifier="contributes_to", current_evidence="IDA", current_ref="PMID:22334663", source="UniProt",
      lead="Retain as is",
      rationale="contributes_to correctly expresses that the activity belongs to the DDB1-DDB2 complex while DDB2 makes the contacts."),
 dict(gene="DDB1", go_id="GO:0070914", go_term="UV-damage excision repair", aspect="BP",
      current_qualifier="involved_in", current_evidence="IDA", current_ref="PMID:14751237 / PMID:22334663", source="ComplexPortal / UniProt",
      lead="Retain",
      rationale="Pathway involvement is independent of whether DDB1 touches DNA; DDB1 delivers DDB2 to CUL4-RBX1."),
 dict(gene="DDB1", go_id="GO:0031464 (candidate)", go_term="Cul4A-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase complex / adaptor role", aspect="CC/MF",
      current_qualifier="-", current_evidence="-", current_ref="PMID:22118460 (4A0K, 4A0L)", source="candidate lead",
      lead="Consider adding or promoting as core",
      rationale="Structures show DDB1 bridging CUL4A/CUL4B-RBX1 to the DCAF; this is the activity DDB1 itself performs."),
])
go.to_csv("TABLE_GO_decision_leads.csv", index=False)
print("\n\nTABLE 2: GO curation leads (require curator verification)\n")
for _,r in go.iterrows():
    print(f"- {r.gene} {r.go_id} {r.go_term} [{r.aspect}] | now: {r.current_qualifier}/{r.current_evidence}/{r.current_ref} ({r.source})")
    print(f"    LEAD: {r.lead}\n    WHY : {r.rationale}")

# ---------- Figure: per-structure distance comparison ----------
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11,6))
idx = np.arange(len(S)); w=0.4
ax.bar(idx-w/2, S.DDB1_min_dist_to_DNA_A, w, color="#B4442E", label="DDB1 (Q16531)")
d2 = S.DDB2_min_dist_to_DNA_A.fillna(0)
ax.bar(idx+w/2, d2, w, color="#2E6FB4", label="DDB2 (Q92466 / Q2YDS1)")
ax.set_xticks(idx); ax.set_xticklabels(S.index, rotation=90, fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(4.0, ls="--", c="grey", lw=1); ax.text(0.2, 5.2, "4 A contact cutoff", fontsize=8, color="grey")
ax.set_ylabel("Minimum heavy-atom distance to DNA (A)")
ax.set_title("DDB2 contacts DNA in every structure; DDB1 stays about 27 A away\n"
             "(5 rightmost entries are CRL4-CSA-Pol II, where DDB1 has no DDB2 partner)", fontsize=11)
ax.legend()
for i,p in enumerate(S.index):
    if np.isnan(d2.iloc[i]) or d2.iloc[i]==0:
        ax.text(i+w/2, 1, "no DDB2", rotation=90, fontsize=6, ha="center", va="bottom")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
